🥥🦐 Round Rock Foodie Find!
Craving coastal flavors in the heart of Texas? 🌴
I stopped by Salt Traders Coastal Cooking for lunch, and WOW — it did not disappoint 😍

Here’s what I ordered:
🍽️ From the lunch menu (served daily 11AM–3PM):
  🍲 Seafood Gumbo (cup) – $7
  🔥 Wood-Fired Chicken Sandwich – $16
🦪 Steamed Mussels – $15
🍰 Coconut Cheesecake – light, creamy, & not too sweet!

✨ My foodie score: 4.8/5
📍Located right here in Round Rock, TX — and yes, I’m coming back! 😋
